patterns.title: Dedicated Post-Delivery Warranty, Defect Resolution & Satisfaction Care
patterns.standard_playbook: Handle cracked/damaged delivery claims, warranty verification, replacement staging, and post-installation check-ins inside the isolated After-Service team separate from frontline sales and pre-order inquiries.
patterns.guardrail_rule: Require order evidence before staging replacement or credit proposals, escalate every financial credit or remake to human approval, and keep post-delivery learning separate from frontline CS.
